initial_findings.finding: Verifier accepted source_admission_sha256 as presence-only provenance and did not compare file digest against an expected value outside the artifact.
initial_findings.resolution: Added server-side manifest and verify-side manifest comparison for artifact_sha256, artifact_payload_sha256, source_admission_sha256, created_at_utc, kind, and write surface.

initial_findings.finding: Verifier accepted artifacts with missing created_at_utc.
initial_findings.resolution: Added parseable timestamp validation before candidate admission.

evidence: Verify compares the selected artifact against manifest entry fields.
Tampered source_admission_sha256 with recomputed artifact_payload_sha256 returns ROLLBACK_POINT_VERIFY_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH.
Missing or invalid created_at_utc returns ROLLBACK_POINT_VERIFY_TIMESTAMP_INVALID.
